presentation.title: A courier introduction
lines: A gym member introduces a courier with a seven-day trial price.

choices.label: Try the courier introduction
choices.detail: Pay a {trial_fee} sign-up fee, then {trial_discount} less on actual parcel labels for {trial_days} days. It only pays off if you ship enough parcels; no cash award.
choices.outcome: The opportunity is ready. Follow its terms and next steps.

choices.label: Decline and keep your current plan
choices.detail: No fee, order or commitment; you pay the full label price. Another opportunity may arrive after 30 days.
